'''4th Regiment''' was an [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] formation based in the city of [[Tiems]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. 4th Regiment fought in the [[Battle of Tiems]], where it was held in reserve to exploit any breakthroughs. When [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] forces fell back along the [[Tiems Road]], 4th Regiment followed [[2nd Regiment (Tiems)|2nd Regiment]] and was caught in a trap by other Alliance forces that almost completely destroyed the unit.

==Behind the scenes==
It is unknown if 4th Regiment was the official name of the unit, or whether it was simply an identifier used by the Alliance for debriefing purposes.
